schema.gain_sign: low cost minus high cost; positive chooses7.5 seconds; ties choose0
schema.training_truth: New paired labels may fit only after both outcomes become available and consume two replacement slots; at-issue prediction errors are descriptive training diagnostics.
schema.heldout_truth: Both native300-second tails are frozen. No heldout target enters any fit. Action regret is a passive decision diagnostic, not deployed day cost.

interpretation.comparator: Shared4-feature wait/ride difference fit and independent route3 fit use exactly the same budget-admitted native pairs on one common controller flow.
interpretation.matching: Only common_metrics compare every model on identical heldout states; per-model metrics retain their actual support.
interpretation.clock: Both response targets have analytic300-second clocks. Global zero-duration rows can consume label slots and supervise fixed300 response, but do not enter world/trust transition fitting.
interpretation.budget: Each pair replaces two ordinary labels in a five-slot packet. Replayed child prefixes are computation, not additional independent training observations.
interpretation.scope: New training prefixes and heldout states replace prior diagnostic points. All models are passive; main day cost is common and cannot establish controller superiority.
